spans.s:
अशौच n. (-चं)
 1. Foulness, impurity.
 2. Legal impurity, contamination,
defilement contracted by the death of a relation, the commission of
prohibited acts, &c.
 E. अ neg. शौच purification.

आशौच n. (-चं) Impurity.
 E. अशुचि impure, अञ् aff.

अशौचत्व n. (-त्वं)
 1. Impure or abandoned nature or diposition.
 2. Defile-
ment, contamination.
 E. त्व added to अशौच.

अशौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Want of heroism, cowardice.
 E. अ neg. शौर्य्य valour.

असौन्दर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Ugliness.
 E. अ neg. सौन्दर्य्य beauty.

असौम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
 1. Ugly, unlovely.
 2. Disagreeable, displeasing.
E. अ neg. सौम्य pleasing.

असौम्यस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having a bad or croaking voice.
 E. असौम्य dis-
agreeable, and स्वर a note or sound.

असौष्ठव n. (-वं)
 1. Ugliness, deformity.
 2. Demerit, worthlessness.
 E. अ
neg. सौष्ठव beauty, &c.
